title: Writing Emails 1
description: Short, real-life emails: invitations, thank-you notes, questions and cancellations. Aim for 60–80 words.

thumbnail.alt: An envelope with an @ symbol and a paper airplane
thumbnail.prompt: An envelope with an @ symbol and a paper airplane. Flat vector illustration, soft warm earthy palette (terracotta, sage green, ochre, muted blue, cream) with a small touch of muted gold, very subtle, even paper grain, simple rounded shapes, gentle soft lighting, centered composition with generous empty space around the subject, mid-tone background that works on both dark and light pages. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no real or famous people, no watermark. Full-bleed flat background color from edge to edge: no frame, no border, no round or oval vignette, no wreath, no mandala or ornament in the middle of the image.

cards.prompt: Your friend invited you to a party on Saturday, but you can't go. Write a short email: thank them, explain why you can't go and suggest another plan.
followUps: Did you start with a greeting and finish with a closing?
Is your email between 60 and 80 words?
